text: Public administration is a discipline that studies how public sectors such as governments and non-profit organizations can efficiently provide public services and solve social problems. Its core lies in enhancing the governance efficiency of public affairs through scientific management methods, ultimately achieving "maximization of public interests". It is based on political science, economics, and sociology, focusing on areas closely related to people's livelihood such as education, healthcare, environmental protection, and social security. From the implementation of community waste sorting to the formulation of national medical insurance policies, all fall within its research and practical scope.
